head: Head
mixPartsFromAnyCreatureDragToRotateWheel: Mix parts from any creature. Drag to rotate, wheel to zoom.
initialSpecialSkillsAndProgressionUnlock: Initial special skills and progression unlocked along the roadmap.
increasesSpellDamageAndAlchemicalPower: Increases spell damage and alchemical power.
increasesHitRateDodgeAndActionSpeed: Increases hit rate, dodge, and action speed.
increasesCriticalHitsAndAlchemicalAnomal: Increases critical hits and alchemical anomalies chance.
selectOneArchetypeTemplateForABaselineCr: Select one archetype template for a baseline creature, or two to splice a hybrid. Confirm a selected archetype to continue.
sculptAUniqueCreatureFromMixedPartsSeede: Sculpt a unique creature from mixed parts, seeded from your chosen archetypes.
dragToRotateWheelToZoomMiddleDragToPan: Drag to rotate · wheel to zoom · middle-drag to pan

originDeserter.name: Deserter
originDeserter.desc: Choose a faction you deserted from: begin with 40 of its troops, but hated by it (and its parent faction).

originFactionLeader.name: Faction Leader
originFactionLeader.desc: Choose a faction and begin in command of 40 of its troops, in good standing with it (and its parent faction), with two weeks of upkeep money.

originWarlord.name: Independent Warlord
originWarlord.desc: Begin in command of 40 troops drawn from random factions, loyal to no one, with enough gold to cover two weeks of their upkeep.

originCrash.name: Crash Landed
originCrash.desc: Begin stranded on a random planet in an uncharted galaxy, ship damaged, nearly out of fuel and with no jump charges left.

originArtifact.name: Artifact Heir
originArtifact.desc: Inherit one of the world's ancient artifacts, chosen at random, along with its history.

originCeo.name: CEO
originCeo.desc: Start rich: €1,000,000 in cash and an 80% controlling stake in LemonCorp, at its headquarters.

originBunker.name: Bunker
originBunker.desc: Wake up in a stocked loot cellar under a random overland biome. Its gold is yours, and the hatch you climb out of stays open forever.

originStranded.name: Stranded
originStranded.desc: Begin on foot at a random remote spot somewhere on the world map.

originCriminal.name: Criminal
originCriminal.desc: Same camper start as the camper origin, but your party begins already wanted with a 10,000€ bounty.

originMayor.name: Mayor
originMayor.desc: Pick a city, then begin there with 50 of every crafting material.

originDungeon.name: Dungeon entrance
originDungeon.desc: Start at the tower gate with a delve kit: extra potions, the tower routes map, a flashlight and a climbing rope.

originLot.name: Empty lot
originLot.desc: Begin on a random patch of the world map with a large stockpile of crafting materials.

originBike.name: Start on bike
originBike.desc: Begin riding a bike somewhere on the world map.

originCar.name: Start in car
originCar.desc: Pick a city, then begin in your car parked there.

originCamper.name: Start in camper
originCamper.desc: Pick a city, then begin in your camper parked there.

originSpace.name: Start in space
originSpace.desc: Skip the map selection and begin your journey out in space.

originTrain.name: Start in train
originTrain.desc: Board the train and pick your destination on the map (default).

rerollCharacter.name: Reroll character
rerollCharacter.desc: Randomize this character again and update the dossier.

ageElder.name: Elder (60+)
ageElder.desc: Old, with a lifetime of stories.

ageYoung.name: Young (18-25)
ageYoung.desc: A young adult, just setting out.

randomTraits.name: Randomize traits
randomTraits.desc: Have traits randomly assigned to your character.

randomClass.name: Random class
randomClass.desc: Be assigned a random starting class.

selectClass.name: Select a class
selectClass.desc: Choose your starting class from a list.

portraitModel.name: 3D Model
portraitModel.desc: Sculpt a procedural 3D model instead of choosing a portrait. \C[1]No bust is used.\C[0]

portraitBust.name: Portrait
portraitBust.desc: Pick a drawn bust from the portrait gallery. Your character is shown as that portrait everywhere.

randomizeAllParty.name: Randomize all party
randomizeAllParty.desc: Fill every party slot with a random character instantly, then choose your origin.

totalRandom.name: Total Random
totalRandom.desc: Create a completely random character instantly.

newCharacter.name: Create New Character
newCharacter.desc: Create a brand new character from scratch.

hometownPick.name: Pick on map
hometownPick.desc: Choose your hometown from the fast-travel map, the same picker used to choose a starting city.

existingCharacter.name: Use Existing Character
existingCharacter.desc: Select from pre-made characters. Each one can be played only once per world.

modeFull.name: Full
modeFull.desc: Detailed creation: choose class, traits, hometown and birth date for every member.

modeQuick.name: Quick
modeQuick.desc: Fast creation for each member: quick class pick, random traits, no flavor steps.

combatMonsters.name: Monsters
combatMonsters.desc: Capture and battle with monsters. \C[1]This cannot be changed later.\C[0]

combatCards.name: Cards
combatCards.desc: Roguelike deck combat. \C[1]This cannot be changed later.\C[0] Each party member draws from their own deck built from their skills and plays cards on their turn using Energy instead of MP/TP.

combatMap.name: Map Battle
combatMap.desc: Tactical fights on the live map instead of a separate battle screen. Move on the tile grid, weapons and skills have a reach, and line of sight matters. Can be changed later in Options.

combatRpg.name: Classic RPG
combatRpg.desc: Standard turn-based combat. Skills cost MP/TP and are picked from your command menu.

peaceful.name: Peaceful
peaceful.desc: Enemies never attack or chase you unless provoked, and you can \C[1]Talk\C[0] to them in battle. Defeat just returns you to your last respawn point.

bloodAndOil.name: Blood and Oil
bloodAndOil.desc: Body parts reduced to zero HP are lost, with permanent stat debuffs. Losing a vital organ kills the character instantly. Allies not resurrected by the end of the battle die permanently.

permadeath.name: Permadeath
permadeath.desc: If your character perishes in battle you must create a new one. Allies not resurrected by the end of the battle die permanently.

roguelite.name: Roguelite
roguelite.desc: If defeated you rewake at the base floor of the dungeon. Fallen allies stay in the party and can be resurrected after battle.

pressOkToOpenCategory: Press OK to open this category.
yourCamperParkedInACity: Your camper, parked in a city
yourCarParkedInACity: Your car, parked in a city
aLootCellarUnderARandomBiome: A loot cellar under a random biome
aPermanentHatchOnTheSurface: A permanent hatch on the surface
aRandomPlanetInAnUnchartedGalaxy: A random planet in an uncharted galaxy
2WeeksOfTheirWagesInCash: 2 weeks of their wages, in cash
gameLanguageAnyMissingTranslationFallsBa: Game language. Any missing translation falls back to English.
revealsTheMapGraduallyAsYouExploreUnvisi: Reveals the map gradually as you explore. Unvisited areas remain hidden in darkness.
theEntireMapIsFullyRevealedNoHiddenAreas: The entire map is fully revealed, no hidden areas.
exploreTileByTileDarknessVeilsTheUnknown: Explore tile by tile, darkness veils the unknown.
everyPartyMemberExceptTheLeaderActsAutom: Every party member except the leader acts automatically in battle, choosing their own actions.
youManuallyControlEveryPartyMemberSActio: You manually control every party member's actions.
onlyTheLeaderIsControlledByYouTheRestFig: Only the leader is controlled by you, the rest fight on their own.
howEnemiesAreShownInBattle2dTheClassicBa: How enemies are shown in battle. 2D: the classic battler image. 3D: procedural 3D models (goblins, slimes, elementals...). Sprites: the enemy's character sprite from its info.
3dRendersProceduralModelsSpritesUsesTheE: 3D renders procedural models, Sprites uses the enemy's character sprite.
masterSwitchForTheDynamicLightingSystemS: Master switch for the dynamic lighting system: streetlights, event lights and the night-light overlay. Turn off for maximum performance.
allDynamicLightsAreDisabledBestPerforman: All dynamic lights are disabled, best performance.
streetlightsAndAmbientLightingReactToThe: Streetlights and ambient lighting react to the time of day.
musicTrackPlayedDuringCombatPressToPrevi: Music track played during combat. Press ←→ to preview tracks.
visualThemeAppliedToMenusAndHudPressToSw: Visual theme applied to menus and HUD. Press ←→ to switch. Requires restart to apply.
howSkillsAndMagicAreGroupedInBattleAndMe: How skills and magic are grouped in battle and menus. Role: pick Offensive, Healing or Support, then the skills inside. School: grouped by magic school or discipline. Off: a plain list.
roleGroupsByPurposeOffensiveHealingSuppo: Role groups by purpose (Offensive/Healing/Support); School groups by discipline.
toCycleTracksPreviewPlaysAutomatically: ← → to cycle tracks · preview plays automatically
toCycleThemesRequiresRestartToApply: ← → to cycle themes · ⟳ requires restart to apply
